kb_silent: CLS-05: the organizer dispute code 'cancellation_fee' matches no organizer_code in TX-CASE (only no_show_charge is mapped; CW-RIDERCANCEL has organizer_code null). The type was set by CLS-06 from who canceled.
TX-CANCELREASON has no value 'rider_cancelled_eta_too_long'. It was read as rider_cancelled (or OTHER with free text); this does not change the outcome.

No rule says whether a gap between the booking screen's nearest-driver estimate (about 4 min, E-APP-01) and the assigned driver's ETA (9 min, E-APP-02) is a ground to waive a rider cancellation fee. CW-R08 measures lateness only against the assignment ETA, and CW-R07 names CW-R08 as its only exception, so CW-R07 was applied as written and GEN-R07 was not invoked. A reviewer could instead read this as an uncovered decision point under GEN-R07.
CW-R08's 'not moving toward the pick-up point' has no operational test or parameter. It was judged from the steadily falling distance to the pin across E-GPS-01..04.

BOUNDARY_MARGIN and MARGIN_WITHIN_SPREAD are defined in CW-F03 for wait margins only. The KB does not say they apply to the CW-R01 free-window margin, so the generic TX-FLAG definition and the AUTH-02 trigger 8 test were applied: margin 20 s, spread 0 s.

Neither CW-R08 nor the playbook says which field holds the 'assignment ETA' for an on-demand trip, or whether a later ETA update replaces it. The original assignment ETA was used: 9 min, which equals trip_data.scheduled_time 08:11:40. The updated 6 min ETA gives the same result.
AUTH-05 components A (5 repeated Judge runs) and R (agreement with the rules engine) cannot be measured by a single KB applier. Both were taken as 1; C stays at least TAU even with A=0.6 or R=0.
PB-INTAKE requires a ticket index of open and closed tickets for the same trip, which is not in the case file. MAT-02 was set to NEW on the strength of the rider's 0 prior disputes.
PB-CW-RIDERCANCEL lists GEN-R05 advocate briefs, which are not in the case file. The parties' statements on file were used instead.

The KB does not say how much of a rider-cancellation fee the driver receives. DRIVER_CANCEL_PAYOUT_SGD (S$4.50) is stated for a driver who cancels after waiting, and open decision D7 leaves S$0.50 unexplained. The payee was set to DRIVER per CW-R09 / FEE_PAYEE without a payout amount.
note: I upheld the fee. The rider canceled 200 s after matching (08:02:40 to 08:06:00 in every trip, app, chat and GPS record), which is 20 s past Ryde's 3-minute free window (CW-R01, CW-R07).
